szenen.text: Jensen Huang walks back into Nvidia's headquarters. Eleven days after he resigned. And the whole building stands up.
His words to the staff: I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around.
And the stock? Nvidia since the comeback: {chg}.
szenen.text_ohne: And the stock? Here is Nvidia since the comeback.

szenen.text: Our view: a comeback made in Washington. The employees cheer. The question is who really runs Nvidia now.
